output.one_liner: Supabase auto-generates an API directly from your database schema allowing you to connect to your database through a restful interface, directly from the browser.

auth.notes: API key auth for Data REST API, Bearer token for Management API personal access tokens (PATs), OAuth2 for third-party applications

evidence.snippet: provisioned behind an API gateway with key-auth enabled
All API requests require an access token to be included in the Authorization header
Personal access token (PAT): PATs are tokens with a custom expiry
OAuth2 allows your application to generate tokens on behalf of a Supabase user

access.notes: Free tier includes 2 active projects with full API access. Projects pause after 1 week inactivity. No approval or sales contact required.

evidence.snippet: Free: Perfect for passion projects & simple websites
Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity
You can find the API Keys in the Settings > API Keys section

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Management API: 120 requests/minute per user/scope/endpoint. Auth endpoints: 30-1800 requests/hour by operation type with burst capacity.

evidence.snippet: Supabase provides a RESTful API using PostgREST
The reflected API is designed to retain as much of Postgres' capability as possible
This reference documents every object and method available in Supabase
Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database
Rate limits are applied to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials, documented REST API, comprehensive SDK with hundreds of methods across database/auth/storage/realtime, webhooks, and explicit rate-limit documentation enable immediate toolkit development.

overview_evidence.snippet: Supabase auto-generates an API directly from your database schema allowing you to connect to your database through a restful interface

unknown_reasons.api_surface: GraphQL API listed in product navigation but detailed documentation not in provided pages; OpenAPI spec URL not provided (SDK method exists but no public spec URL given)
